content:
As the Mender and <@!443806147649208341>  fly over Staaten as forms of mist, dark thunderclouds gather above.  Below them they see the ruins of Staaten.  Many redcoats have setup camps in the derelict buildings.  A few factories seem to still be running in places.  As the rain begins to fall, they fly lower.  They pass one factory where it looks like berries are being harvested from tens of thousands of rose bushes.  Another seems to be making arms.

After a while they land among a few trees that are left standing in what used to be a neighborhood.  Houses all around them are scraps of their former selves.  The rain pours thickly, the thunder cracks, lightning flashes in the clouds.  Sometimes the lightning comes down from the heavens, others up to the clouds.

The Mender becomes solid once more and motions for Ed
Ed solidifies next to Mender and still seems a bit exhilarated from the flight. They look around the place
The mender pulls out a 1 meter block of Basalt from his vest, and sets it on the ground.  He puts his mouth close to Ed ears so he doesn't have to talk so loud, and says "Do you remember the words?"
Ed nods and takes out the scriber from their pocket

Ed hops over, a bit of fear on their face, but they push through it and start slowly to trace these words onto the stone. Their face is scrunched up in concentration and they silently voice out the letters 

`Just as hope is the light that guides man safely through troubled waters
The spirit of man weathers any storm, 
Giving them the resolve needed to build a better tomorrow.`

As Ed writes the words in the Basalt, Runes and Glyphs encompass its every surface.  They start out a dull red, but as the words continue being written, they glow brighter.  They appear on the ground around the Basalt.  When the last word is written, a flash of blinding light, and an echoing boom happen.

As The Mender and Ed's eyes clear, there is a circle around them cleared of all vegetation, having been burned away.  There i a smell of ozone, and static fills the air.  Somehow the Lightning that struck them didn't hurt them, and the stone is now set. <@!313689699627696139> (The Staaten Stone is set.  This is the future site of the Staaten Island Lighthouse, made in 1912)
the Mender looks at the stone, quite pleased "Ready to head back?" (he appears unphased by the lightning strike that just hit)
An Extra Fluffy Ed just blinks a couple times, looks at the burnt vegetation and does the thumbs up to Mender with a smile
The mender smiles and turns back to mist, waiting for Ed to join him
Ed hops following and turns back into Ed-mist

As they fly back to the <#861700807626588220> , Ed can see many camps of redcoats having been hit by lightning.  (the storm over Staaten will last a few hours, but the lightning will stop shortly after The mender has left the area.)
